whenToUse: The per-day (or per-week) uptime row of a service on a status page or health dashboard.
Showing at a glance which periods had outages, degradation or maintenance, with details on hover and focus.
avoidWhen: A continuous metric over time such as latency or error rate — use a bar or line chart.
A single current state — use a badge or alert.
a11y: One tab stop per row with arrow, Home and End keys (RTL aware); every bar's accessible name holds its date, state, uptime and note, so the tooltip is never the only source.
State is not colour-only: bars dip in height by severity, maintenance is hatched, no data is dashed, and UptimeLegend names each state in text.
